about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Michael A. Rulli

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I am proud to stand in support of H.R. 7726, the Stop Child Care Scams Act of 2026.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues today to support this bill, strengthen integrity, and safeguard taxpayer dollars in the childcare block grant program.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAVING HOMEOWNERS FROM OVERREGULATION WITH EXCEPTIONAL RINSING ACT
statements.title: SAVING HOMEOWNERS FROM OVERREGULATION WITH EXCEPTIONAL RINSING ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of Congressman Fry's SHOWER Act.
I am not going to pull a Nancy Pelosi, Mr. Speaker.
I am not going to rip up the speech that I had written, but I am not going to give that speech.
I will tell you how I came to Congressman Fry's bill and how I got interested in it.
We are going to fix healthcare.
We are going to fix affordability.
Mr. Speaker, I urge support of H.R. 4593 and so should you.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMBATING THE LIES OF AUTHORITARIANS IN SCHOOL SYSTEMS ACT
statements.title: COMBATING THE LIES OF AUTHORITARIANS IN SCHOOL SYSTEMS ACT
sentences: That is why I urge a ``yes'' vote from all my colleagues, especially from the other side of the aisle.
I urge a ``yes'' vote today on H.R. 1005, otherwise known as the CLASS Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL COAL COUNCIL REESTABLISHMENT ACT
statements.title: NATIONAL COAL COUNCIL REESTABLISHMENT ACT
sentences: They look for power from countries like Russia, like China, and like India to use their coal-powered, generated plants to support their grid.
They want to make sure that the artificial intelligence companies and the data mining companies come to Ohio.
Mr. Speaker, I thank Chair Latta for his leadership, and I rise in support of H.R. 3015, the National Coal Council Reestablishment Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all my colleagues today to have a ``yes'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I stand here today in support of H.R. 28, and I urge the House to pass this bill.
